The reviewer independently reproduced both arms in scratch trees under $TMPDIR: base (b1debac9, changed files at base) 83 passed EXIT=0; head (8f84859aa): head module files overlaid on the base tree, 89 passed EXIT=0. The six added tests all pass, and no test fails at head that passes at base, so added_failure_count=0. Independently reproduced negative control (base graph_ops.py over the head tree) reds TestPathPrefixScan::test_claim_query_includes_prefix_predicate_when_given (1 failed, EXIT=1).

findings.text: The plan's done-when as literally stated is not met at the default candidate limit: _search_code('SELENE equilibrium reconstruction', facility='jt-60sa') returns the string 'No code examples found for SELENE equilibrium reconstruction at jt-60sa.' (verified live by the reviewer). The scoped chunk is only reachable with a raised limit: k=10000 returns 2 matches including /analysis/src/SAselene_v2.0_forPSRC/eqequb.f. Root cause is facility_id post-filtering after the ANN cut over the shared 222,154-chunk index in imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py, outside this node's write fence; the reviewed fragment and manifest name it as a follow-on rather than hiding it. The node satisfied the deliverable by raising k, which the fragment states. No defect in the changed code, but the search-completeness gap remains open and unguarded by any test.

Record gap, not a code defect: the reviewed manifest omits the baseline_suite and after_suite keys the review contract expects, so its gate evidence lives only in tests/test_logs rather than a parsed arm pair. The reviewer reconstructed the arms from the run's own logs and an independent reproduction; the practice should be repaired in the reviewed node's record so a future reader does not have to.
